summary: Remote shell execution via hardcoded WebSocket relay in vanexa-agent
details: vanexa-agent runs a daemon (invoked via `vanexa-agent start`) that opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded relay URL and processes `task_request` messages from the remote side. Task content is dispatched into an AgentLoop that exposes a `terminal.exec` tool spawning `/bin/bash -c <command>` on Unix or `cmd.exe /c <command>` on Windows. Whoever controls the relay endpoint can execute arbitrary shell commands on any host running the daemon. The default `relayUrl` in config.js is `https://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev` — a personal `workers.dev` subdomain (`hanazaki542`) that does not match the vendor's branding (`vanexa.app`, `vanexa-installer.vercel.app` referenced in the README). The daemon also auto-migrates older config entries to this URL, so task-source authority for every installed daemon sits under an individual Cloudflare Workers account rather than the branded vendor infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
